syllabus_body:
CS 101: Introduction to Algorithms & Systems

Instructor: Prof. Ada Lovelace | Credits: 4.0

Course AI Policy

AI collaboration is permitted exclusively for conceptual understanding and hint exploration. All final submitted implementations and proof arguments must be written by the student. Direct code generation or automated synthesis is strictly prohibited.

Grading Scheme

Homework (40%), Midterm Exams (30%), Final Project (30%). Drop-lowest and drop-highest rules apply to homework.
